gate.rule: MECHANISM_INERT iff the orthogonal share < 0.05 and cos(E g_tot, E g_dir) > 0.995 (unbiased cross-group estimates over 64 episodes in 8 groups at START, MODEL_FIT only, before any arm is fitted); otherwise MECHANISM_ACTIVE

mf_reader_check.note: descriptive MODEL_FIT out-of-fold readers; never a decision input

recipe.episodes: household-separated A / E row sets per step from np.random.default_rng(seed_for("RFA1-episodes", v)); identical in FULL, STOPFIT and ALTCRIT
recipe.income: START's income network, frozen bitwise (a constant input of the pair view)
recipe.lambda: calibrated once per training unit on the FULL objective at START (rho x median ||grad CE_occ|| / median ||grad S||, 16 fixed draws) and reused unchanged by STOPFIT and ALTCRIT
recipe.occupation: START's occupation network, trained with CE_occ + lambda S (S from rfa.fam.rfit.EpisodeObjective)
recipe.start: deployed: NEURAL_RAW_S<v> (rho 1 E2) weights; fold k: the U0 recipe refitted on the fold training rows, then RAW-J 80 steps (sar.fb.pfo.rawj_path)
recipe.task_rows: NEURAL_RAW task stream (np.random.default_rng(seed_for("THP1task", v)) epoch permutations)

recipe_rf.altcrit_init: exact fit on the first call's A rows (a converged warm critic at START)
recipe_rf.altcrit_order: per call: critic update on this episode's A rows at the current release, then the release gradient through E
recipe_rf.base_recipe: RFA1-reader-fit-recipe-v1 (every v1 value unchanged except families, family_features and ridge_by_family)
recipe_rf.diagnostics: per term R, AUC_b (E), orientation sign of dmu (E), exact Mann-Whitney AUC (E and A), Newton iterations, final max |grad|, cond(H); FULL: ||grad_w R||, ||v||, output-space norms of the direct (E outputs) and fit (A outputs) contributions

episode.pool: the training rows of the unit (fold training rows / all MODEL_FIT rows for the deployed fit)
episode.separation: household (no unit in both A and E)
episode.sizes_rationale: n_A ~ the declared recipient auxiliary FIT sample (~4,000, MODEL_SELECT FIT parts 0-4), so the fit path describes a reader with that much auxiliary data; n_E ~ its SCORE part (~2,400)

family_features.rff: [s, sqrt(2) cos(s Omega_v + b_v), 1]; Omega_v ~ N(0, 1 / d_v) (d_v x 64), b_v ~ U(0, 2 pi)
family_features.softbin: [soft one-hot bins (B per coordinate of s), soft decision(s), 1]; pair: bins of 5 coordinates + the 10 products d_inc (x) d_occ + 1

recipe_rf.inner_loss: mean binary cross-entropy of SEX + ridge / 2 * ||w||^2 over all non-intercept weights (intercept unpenalized)
recipe_rf.moments_convention: mu_A and sd_A are detached constants of each call, so the FULL fit path runs through w* only (no derivative through the standardization); STOPFIT and ALTCRIT share the convention (as FB_PFD poly2)
recipe_rf.newton: from w = 0 (or the previous call's w* when newton_warm_start), Armijo backtracking (c = 1e-4, halving) while max |grad| >= 1e-5, full steps below; stop at max |grad| <= newton_target or when it stalls below newton_tol
recipe_rf.rff_seed: torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed_for("RFA1-rff", view) mod 2^62); frozen, identical in every version / fold
recipe_rf.softbin_decision: d_r = softmax(z_r / (tau * scale_r)); scale_r = DETACHED A-row RMS SD of recipient r logit differences (income: SD of z1 - z0; occupation: sqrt(mean_k Var(z_k - z0)))
recipe_rf.softbin_membership: softmax over the B bins of -(s - c_b)^2 / (2 width^2), per coordinate (memberships sum to 1)
recipe_rf.softbin_ridge_rationale: memberships have variance ~ 1/B; ridge 1e-3 gives about the per-feature shrinkage of ridge 1e-2 on the unit-variance v1 features (fixed a priori)
recipe_rf.standardization: per view: (u - mean_A) / sd_A with the DETACHED A-row mean and population SD; then c tanh(s / c)
recipe_rf.surrogate: S = sum over views of the MEAN over families of (AUC_b - 1/2)^2; AUC_b = Phi(dmu / sqrt(var_1 + var_0)) of the held-out reader score t_E = phi(E) w*; population variances, NOT detached (no temperature; exactly scale- and shift-invariant in t)
recipe_rf.view_inputs: income: z1 - z0 (1); occupation: z_k - z0, k = 1..4 (4); pair: both (5); z = centred float64 logits
recipe_rf.views_rationale: the loop trains the occupation network only; income logits are START constants, so the income-view term has no gradient and is skipped; the pair view keeps the constant income coordinate

selection.rule: k* = the largest checkpoint S_k (every 10 steps from START) such that S_10..S_k all keep estimate + 2 household-clustered SE <= BUDGET_OCC on the five occupation components of the MODEL_FIT out-of-fold paired spend over the fold start (the U0 recipe; folds RFA_xf_FAM_S<v>); the income vector is START's
